summary.zh-CN: 版本控制记录文件的历史快照；Git 是分布式版本控制工具，提交（commit）是历史的最小单位。
summary.en: Version control records snapshots of file history; Git is distributed, and a commit is the smallest unit of history.

zh-CN: 说明版本控制解决什么问题
说出仓库、提交、分支三个核心概念
解释分布式与集中式的差别
en: Explain what version control solves
Name repository, commit, and branch as core concepts
Explain distributed versus centralized version control

prompt.zh-CN: 用自己的话说明：为什么改代码前要提交一次，而不是一直改到满意再提交？
prompt.en: In your own words: why commit before big changes instead of waiting until everything looks right?

hint.zh-CN: 提交是安全点：出问题时可以回到上一个提交，也方便对比改动。
hint.en: A commit is a safe point: you can return to it and diff changes easily.

summary.zh-CN: git init 在本地新建仓库，git clone 把远端仓库复制到本地；.gitignore 排除不该提交的文件。
summary.en: git init creates a local repository, git clone copies a remote one, and .gitignore excludes files that should not be committed.

zh-CN: 用 git init 初始化仓库
用 git clone 获取远端仓库
写 .gitignore 排除构建产物与密钥
en: Initialize a repository with git init
Clone a remote repository
Write .gitignore for build output and secrets

prompt.zh-CN: 写出初始化仓库、创建 .gitignore（忽略 *.log 和 .env）的两条命令/文件内容。
prompt.en: Write the commands/file content to initialize a repo and a .gitignore ignoring *.log and .env.

hint.zh-CN: git init 之后新建 .gitignore 文件，每行一个模式。
hint.en: After git init, create .gitignore with one pattern per line.

summary.zh-CN: Git 有三个区域：工作区、暂存区、仓库；git add 把改动放进暂存区，git status 显示它们的状态。
summary.en: Git has three areas: working tree, staging area, and repository; git add stages changes and git status shows their state.

zh-CN: 说出工作区、暂存区、仓库的区别
用 git status 判断文件处于哪个状态
用 git add 选择性暂存
en: Distinguish working tree, staging area, and repository
Use git status to tell a file's state
Stage selectively with git add

prompt.zh-CN: 解释：为什么 git status 里同一个文件会同时出现“已暂存”和“未暂存”两种改动？
prompt.en: Explain why one file can appear as both staged and unstaged in git status.

hint.zh-CN: 暂存之后又修改了文件，新改动留在工作区，所以会出现两份差异。
hint.en: If you edit after staging, the new edit stays in the working tree, producing two diffs.

summary.zh-CN: git commit 把暂存区的改动保存为一个快照，并附上提交信息；信息应说明“改了什么、为什么”。
summary.en: git commit saves staged changes as a snapshot with a message describing what changed and why.

zh-CN: 创建一次提交
写清一个提交信息
说明一次提交只做一件事的好处
en: Create a commit
Write a clear commit message
Explain the benefit of one-commit-one-purpose

prompt.zh-CN: 为“修复笔记标题为空时崩溃”这个改动写一条提交信息（英文或中文均可）。
prompt.en: Write a commit message for "fix crash when a note title is empty" (English or Chinese).

hint.zh-CN: 推荐格式：type: 简短说明，例如 fix: reject empty note titles。
hint.en: A common format is type: short summary, e.g. fix: reject empty note titles.

summary.zh-CN: git log 查看提交历史，git diff 查看改动内容；先看差异再提交能避免误提交。
summary.en: git log shows commit history and git diff shows changes; reviewing diffs before committing avoids accidents.

zh-CN: 用 git log --oneline 浏览历史
用 git diff 对比工作区与暂存区
在提交前审查自己的改动
en: Browse history with git log --oneline
Compare working tree and staging area with git diff
Review your own changes before committing

prompt.zh-CN: 说明 git diff、git diff --staged、git show <commit> 三个命令各自比较什么。
prompt.en: Explain what git diff, git diff --staged, and git show <commit> each compare.

hint.zh-CN: 工作区 vs 暂存区、暂存区 vs 最新提交、某个提交的内容。
hint.en: Working tree vs staging, staging vs last commit, and a specific commit's contents.

summary.zh-CN: 分支指向某条提交线，让并行开发互不干扰；HEAD 指向当前所在分支。
summary.en: A branch points at a line of commits so parallel work stays separate; HEAD points at the current branch.

zh-CN: 创建和切换分支
说明 HEAD 的含义
在主分支之外开发新功能
en: Create and switch branches
Explain what HEAD means
Develop a feature outside the main branch

prompt.zh-CN: 从 main 创建 feature-login 分支，切换过去，再切回 main，写出三条命令。
prompt.en: Create feature-login from main, switch to it, then switch back to main — write the three commands.

hint.zh-CN: git switch -c feature-login；git switch feature-login；git switch main。
hint.en: git switch -c feature-login; git switch feature-login; git switch main.

summary.zh-CN: git merge 把一个分支的提交并入当前分支；能快进时直接前移指针，否则生成合并提交。
summary.en: git merge brings another branch's commits into the current branch: fast-forward when possible, otherwise a merge commit.

zh-CN: 把功能分支合并回 main
区分快进合并与三方合并
说明合并提交的作用
en: Merge a feature branch back into main
Distinguish fast-forward from three-way merge
Explain the role of a merge commit

prompt.zh-CN: 先合并 feature-login，再用 git log --oneline --graph 观察历史形状，描述快进发生了什么。
prompt.en: Merge feature-login, then inspect with git log --oneline --graph and describe what fast-forward did.

hint.zh-CN: 快进时 main 只是移动到 feature-login 的位置，不产生新提交。
hint.en: During fast-forward, main simply moves to feature-login's tip with no new commit.

summary.zh-CN: 两个分支改了同一处时合并会产生冲突，Git 在文件中写入冲突标记，需要人工选择保留内容。
summary.en: When both branches change the same place, merging conflicts; Git writes conflict markers into the file for humans to resolve.

zh-CN: 认出冲突标记的结构
选择或合并双方改动并删除标记
用 git add / git commit 完成冲突解决
en: Recognize the structure of conflict markers
Choose or combine both sides and delete markers
Finish resolution with git add / git commit

prompt.zh-CN: 给定一段含 <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> 的文件，说明解决冲突的完整步骤。
prompt.en: Given a file containing <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>, describe the full conflict resolution steps.

hint.zh-CN: 编辑保留目标内容 → 删除三个标记 → git add 该文件 → git commit 完成合并。
hint.en: Edit to the desired content, remove all three markers, git add the file, then git commit.

summary.zh-CN: 远程仓库是团队共享的 Git 仓库；fetch 只下载、pull 拉取并合并、push 上传本地提交。
summary.en: A remote is a shared Git repository: fetch downloads, pull downloads and merges, and push uploads local commits.

zh-CN: 添加并查看远程仓库
区分 fetch 与 pull
安全地 push 到共享分支
en: Add and inspect remotes
Distinguish fetch from pull
Push safely to shared branches

prompt.zh-CN: 解释 fetch 之后还需要做什么才能让本地分支包含远端改动，pull 又是如何一步完成的。
prompt.en: Explain what is still needed after fetch for a local branch to include remote changes, and how pull does it in one step.

hint.zh-CN: fetch 只更新远程跟踪分支；还要 merge 或 rebase。pull 等于 fetch + merge。
hint.en: fetch only updates remote-tracking branches; you still merge or rebase. pull is fetch plus merge.

summary.zh-CN: reset 移动分支指针、revert 生成反向提交、stash 临时收起改动；已推送的历史优先用 revert。
summary.en: reset moves the branch pointer, revert creates an inverse commit, and stash shelves changes; prefer revert for pushed history.

zh-CN: 区分 soft / mixed / hard reset
用 revert 撤销已推送的提交
用 stash 暂存未完成改动
en: Distinguish soft / mixed / hard reset
Undo a pushed commit with revert
Shelve work in progress with stash

prompt.zh-CN: 想撤销刚做的本地提交但保留改动，该用哪条命令？想撤销已经推送到远端的提交呢？
prompt.en: Which command undoes the latest local commit but keeps the changes? And for a commit already pushed?

hint.zh-CN: 本地用 git reset --soft HEAD~1；已推送用 git revert HEAD。
hint.en: Locally use git reset --soft HEAD~1; for pushed history use git revert HEAD.

summary.zh-CN: Pull Request 把功能分支的改动提交评审：先推送分支，再创建 PR，评审通过后合并到主分支。
summary.en: A pull request submits a feature branch for review: push the branch, open a PR, and merge to the main branch after approval.

zh-CN: 描述从分支到 PR 到合并的流程
写出清晰的 PR 描述（改了什么、怎么验证）
回应评审意见并更新 PR
en: Describe the branch-to-PR-to-merge flow
Write a clear PR description (what changed, how verified)
Address review comments and update the PR

prompt.zh-CN: 为“修复登录页空密码崩溃”的 PR 写一个三段式描述：背景、改动、验证。
prompt.en: Write a three-part PR description for "fix empty-password crash on login": context, change, verification.

hint.zh-CN: 验证部分写具体命令/结果，例如“新增单测 test_login_empty_password，全部通过”。
hint.en: Verification should name concrete commands/results, e.g. a new unit test passing.

summary.zh-CN: 功能分支工作流：从 main 拉分支、小步提交、推送、PR、合并、删除分支；rebase 与 tag 用于保持历史整洁与发布。
summary.en: Feature-branch workflow: branch from main, commit in small steps, push, open a PR, merge, delete the branch; rebase and tags keep history and releases clean.

zh-CN: 按功能分支工作流完成一次完整改动
说明 rebase 与 merge 对历史的影响
用 tag 标记发布版本
en: Complete a change via the feature-branch workflow
Explain how rebase and merge affect history
Mark releases with tags

prompt.zh-CN: 写出一个功能从开始到合并的完整命令序列（至少 6 步），并标出哪一步需要人工评审。
prompt.en: Write the full command sequence for a feature from start to merge (at least 6 steps), marking where human review happens.

hint.zh-CN: switch -c → 修改 → add → commit → push → PR → 评审 → merge → 删分支。
hint.en: switch -c, edit, add, commit, push, PR, review, merge, delete the branch.
